question: Chain a CAST-carrying body end to end, all five links, and establish what EvalIR can express about casts - is there a cast case in the instruction evaluator at all, or is this a build item like the float arms were?
why_this_one_of_the_three: It is the only TRUNC in the crate. Information is LOST: trunc u64 -> u32 is n mod 2^32, so distinct inputs collapse, and the refinement theorem has to be exact about which information survives. A zero extension is an injective embedding whose theorem says the value is unchanged, which is the least a cast can say.

The other two cast bodies are the SAME BODY TWICE - identical instruction sequence, instr count, canonical-line count, marker count and call counts, differing only in a struct id. Chaining one would be chaining one of a duplicated pair.

The producer's own interpreter differential RAN on it (agreed, 5 samples). Both zext bodies are `not-run` because their parameter is a by-value newtype struct, so this body carries strictly more producer-side evidence.
Its closure environment parameter has the UNIT type `()` rather than `ptr` - a signature shape no chained body has.

IS_A_CAST_EXPRESSIBLE_IN_EVALIR.answer: YES, EXACTLY, AND IT ALREADY WAS. No build item was needed on the semantics side - which is the OPPOSITE of the float lane's finding and is why the question had to be asked rather than assumed.
what_already_existed: IRInst.cast : IRCastOp -> IRTy -> IRTy -> Nat -> IRInst (spec/core_spec/eval_ir_syntax.rs)
IRCastOp with 17/17 of trust_ir::CastOp in declaration order (same file)
the exact typed evaluators ir_trunc_eval / ir_zext_eval / ir_sext_eval, plus ir_ptrtoint_eval / ir_ptrcast_eval / ir_reifyfn_eval
the machine's own case: `IRInst.cast op sr ds a => ir_bind_result s rs (ir_cast_eval op sr ds (ir_getd s a))` (spec/core_spec/eval_ir_machine.rs)
four pre-existing kernel-executed cast witnesses (ir_exact_trunc_low_bit, ir_exact_zext_canonicalizes, ir_exact_sext_negative, ir_inttoptr_fails_closed)
IS_A_CAST_EXPRESSIBLE_IN_EVALIR.what_WAS_the_build_item: THE CFG GATE. Before this chain a cast was in NO lane of tests/crystal_a1_lineage/emitted_cfg.rs, so a body whose entire content is `trunc` + `ret` parsed to an ENTIRELY EMPTY Cfg on both sides - and two empty CFGs compare equal. Every assertion the gate had would have passed against a transcription with no cast at all. The `casts` and `cast_tys` lanes are this lane's build item, and they are the same class of hole the eighth chain found with binop_tys and rets.

both_widths_are_semantic_and_the_float_l.destination: ir_trunc_int returns ir_wrap dw x, so trunc u64 -> u32 and trunc u64 -> u8 are different functions of the same operand. Registered as ir_gc_dest_width_is_semantic, for every n.
both_widths_are_semantic_and_the_float_l.source: the guard is ir_nat_leb dw sw, so trunc u8 -> u32 is ir_width_fault where trunc u64 -> u32 is a value. The source width decides FAULT versus VALUE and is NOT implied by the operand - the half with no analogue in binop_tys, because a binop has one type and a cast has two. Registered as ir_gc_source_width_is_semantic, for every scalar.
both_widths_are_semantic_and_the_float_l.opcode: zext requires sw <= dw, so zext u64 -> u32 at this chain's own widths is ir_width_fault where its trunc answers. Registered as ir_gc_opcode_is_semantic, for every scalar.
both_widths_are_semantic_and_the_float_l.usize: left UNRESOLVED (`?usize`) rather than decided at an assumed width, and assert_lanes refuses an unresolved cast type on EITHER side. The two unchained zext bodies emit it, so a later lane fails closed there until someone decides.

IS_A_CAST_EXPRESSIBLE_IN_EVALIR.exactness: TOTAL, unlike the float lane. ir_wrap dw x is the canonical low-dw residue with no rounding, no saturation and no tagged refusal, so this chain's A4 concludes IROutcome.ret and reuses the existing ret-only fuel monotonicity (ir_run_le_ret) rather than needing a new one.

refused_and_why.unconditional periodicity: ir_wrap 32 (n + 2^32) = ir_wrap 32 n for EVERY n is NOT proved. It needs ir_nat_rem periodicity, which nobody has earned, and buying it with the kernel-native Nat.div/Nat.mod would add ACCELERATED CONSTANTS whose declared bodies the kernel never consults - speed bought with trust, refused by the float lane on exactly this ground for finite-plus-finite. What IS proved generally is the conditional form: equal low words give equal outcomes (ir_gc_high_word_is_discarded). The collapse itself is EXECUTED at 7 and 2^32 + 7.
refused_and_why.bitcast / transmute / inttoptr: still the tagged unmodelled width_bounded outcome. No body in clean-kernel flips one, so a semantics for them would be modelling with no artifact to be about.
